summary: Practise MLflow pipelines, drift monitoring, and model risk controls in applied labs. Explore the five-day MLOps course and syllabus.
lede: MLOps and model risk training helps ML engineers, data engineers, model risk managers, and technology leads control production machine-learning workflows. Learners map model inventories and approval evidence, design versioned pipeline and release controls, and assess drift, performance, and fairness signals for monitoring and escalation. Practical exercises use MLflow, Evidently, and Fairlearn, with ISO AI governance and risk-management concepts introduced as references.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical and risk professionals who contribute to machine-learning development, approval, deployment, or oversight in regulated organizations. It suits intermediate practitioners who need to connect engineering workflows with model risk controls.
modules: NIST AI RMF and ML Lifecycle
ISO AI Risk and Model Controls
prerequisites: Working knowledge of machine-learning concepts and basic Python is required. Participants should be familiar with model development or technology risk processes. Coding is used for guided lab tasks; advanced software engineering experience is not required. Bring a laptop with Python available, or confirm lab access and setup arrangements before delivery.
